# Titles a real library of 168 books actually produced, as PlausibleTitle sees
# them. A line marked BAD must be rejected; every other line must be accepted.
#
# The bad ones all came from the MODEL rather than from the files: asked for a
# book's title, gemma4-12b sometimes answers with the whole title page, and
# once with a remark about the title page, which was then shown on a shelf as
# the name of a book.
#
# Real titles are here too, and they are the more important half: rejecting one
# puts a book on the shelf as "Untitled" and leaves somebody guessing. The
# longest real title here is 159 characters and the shortest dumped title page
# is 278, which is where the length limit comes from.
